description_text: Responsible for all segments of the general accounting function. Supervises the maintenance of one or more accounting systems directly. Maintains or oversees the maintenance of accounts and records in such areas as disbursements, expenses, tax payments, and income. The accountant would be responsible for all aspects of finances in our entity. This position would be responsible for but not be limited to: Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, purchasing, invoicing / factura, IVA (taxes), tax submissions and returns, book keeping, monthly reports (local Mexico / corporate USA), aging / collections, inventory, accruals, journal entries, MEARS reporting, inter-company transfers, and overseeing / backup the admin assistant position (general office duties).
